title: SessionStart input
description: Fires when Zed creates an agent conversation object (gpui observe_new). Notification only in Zed.

source.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1266). Zed sends "startup" for a new conversation and "resume" for a reopened one; the other Claude Code values are never sent.

model.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1267) (optional there too). Id of the model of the conversation.
